title: Which U.S. state will be the first to settle its lawsuit against TikTok over youth-safety claims?
background: TikTok faces lawsuits from U.S. states alleging that its platform harms young users and misleads consumers about its safety protections.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Official announcements from state attorneys general, supported by reliable contemporaneous news reporting. 
  Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the U.S. state that reaches the first publicly announced settlement agreement with TikTok resolving a state lawsuit over youth safety and allegedly misleading safety claims. The agreement must be announced by September 30, 2026. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The name of the U.S. state.
